english.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when representing something mainly in words or speech.
This is the all-purpose choice when portraying something in words or conveying its characteristics.
Use this when the focus is describing something rather than summarizing a whole text.

examples.english: This interview uses simple words to depict life in the fishing village.
examples.traditional: 呢段訪問用好簡單嘅說話描述咗個漁村嘅生活。
